purpose: Research template; all 200 records are intentionally unverified. This file is not loaded as verified website data.

coverageTypes.name: Factory warranty
coverageTypes.note: Original manufacturer warranty repairs. Existing warranty summaries are carried forward; coverage applicability and mandatory versus optional treatment need a dedicated review.

coverageTypes.name: Manufacturer-backed service contract
coverageTypes.note: Includes programs such as Subaru Added Security. Verify the issuer, obligor, administrator and manufacturer affiliation; the program name alone does not establish statutory coverage.

coverageTypes.name: CPO warranty
coverageTypes.note: Certified pre-owned warranty repair claims. Separate these from certification inspections, reconditioning and any separately purchased service contract.

coverageTypes.name: Independent service contract
coverageTypes.note: A service contract with an independent obligor. A third-party labor-time guide is a different concept and does not establish coverage for these contracts.

methodDefinitions.name: Retail rate benchmark
methodDefinitions.description: Broad reference, floor or available route based on retail charges. Does not by itself establish an unconditional retail rate or a particular sample formula.

methodDefinitions.name: Posted retail rate
methodDefinitions.description: Express use of the dealer’s posted hourly rate, with applicable statutory conditions.

methodDefinitions.name: Financial-statement formula
methodDefinitions.description: An hourly-rate alternative calculated from dealership financial information.

methodDefinitions.name: OEM-hour-normalized rate
methodDefinitions.description: Retail labor revenue divided by OEM-guide hours. The time difference is incorporated into the rate; do not apply an additional time multiplier without authority.

methodDefinitions.name: Other hourly-rate method
methodDefinitions.description: A specified method not captured above, such as a contract rate, negotiated rate, regional benchmark or statutory minimum. Describe the method and who may choose it.

methodDefinitions.name: Multiplier on factory hours
methodDefinitions.description: An explicit factor changes OEM-guide paid hours. Record the exact factor or ratio, conditions and election rights; this is not an hourly-dollar-rate multiplier.

methodDefinitions.name: Factory / OEM guide
methodDefinitions.description: Express legal use of OEM-guide hours, including an election where applicable. Do not assume this category merely because no alternative rule was found.

methodDefinitions.name: Third-party time guide
methodDefinitions.description: An independent labor-guide publisher supplies allowed hours. This does not mean an independent service-contract provider.

methodDefinitions.name: Dealer customer-pay guide
methodDefinitions.description: The dealer’s guide used for retail customer-paid repairs. May overlap with a third-party guide when the text supports both.

methodDefinitions.name: Agreed time guide
methodDefinitions.description: A time guide selected by agreement. Using an extended-warranty guide for factory warranty pricing does not itself bring service contracts within the statute.

methodDefinitions.name: Actual technician time
methodDefinitions.description: Documented actual time, whether the primary method or a conditional fallback. Record which, including diagnostic and technical-assistance treatment.

methodDefinitions.name: Other paid-hours method
methodDefinitions.description: Describe any other express time method. Silence about time allowances is not an OEM-guide mandate or a reasonable-time standard.

methodDefinitions.name: Guide rule — split pending
methodDefinitions.description: Existing broad category combining retail, independent and agreed guides. Its count must not be presented as the count for any one of those narrower categories.
